import numpy as np, os,re,json
from scipy import ndimage
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
G={k:np.array(v) for k,v in G.items()}

def comps(inp,bg):
    lab,n=ndimage.label(inp!=bg, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=[]
    for j in range(1,int(n)+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==j)
        y0,x0=int(min(ys)),int(min(xs))
        sub=inp[y0:int(max(ys))+1,x0:int(max(xs))+1]
        out.append((int(len(ys)),(y0,x0),sub))
    return out

def solve(inp):
    inp=np.array(inp); H,W=inp.shape
    bg=int(np.bincount(inp.flat).argmax())
    cs=comps(inp,bg); cs.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0],reverse=True)
    T=cs[0][2]; ty_,tx_=cs[0][1]
    TM=(T!=bg)
    out=inp.copy()
    # anchors: template cells; for each seed try placing anchor on seed
    seeds=[]
    for sz,p,_ in cs:
        if sz==1: seeds.append((p[0],p[1]))
    res=[]
    for sr,sc in seeds:
        svals=set([inp[sr][sc]])
        # allow any template cell, including bg-colored ones, as long as stamp fits and paints bg
        best=None
        for ap in [(r,c) for r in range(T.shape[0]) for c in range(T.shape[1])]:
            v=T[ap[0]][ap[1]]
            ar=sr-ap[0]; ac=sc-ap[1]
            # valid placement: all non-bg template cells land on bg
            good=0; tot=0; ok=True
            for r in range(T.shape[0]):
                for c in range(T.shape[1]):
                    vv=T[r][c]
                    if vv==bg: continue
                    pr,pc=ar+r,ac+c
                    if not(0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W): ok=False; break
                    tot+=1
                    if inp[pr][pc]==bg: good+=1
            if ok and best is None or good>best[0]: best=(good,tot,ar,ac)
        for r in range(T.shape[0]):
            for c in range(T.shape[1]):
                v=T[r][c]
                if v==bg: continue
                pr,pc=best[2]+r,best[3]+c
                if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W: out[pr][pc]=v
    return out

for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    got=solve(G[nm+' input']); exp=G[nm+' output']
    d=np.argwhere(got!=exp)
    print(nm,"match:",(got==exp).all(),"ndiff",len(d))
    for r,c in d[:20]: print(" ",int(r),int(c),"got",got[r][c],"want",exp[r][c])
